purpose: Validates a royalty-split configuration against ERC-2981 and 0xSplits rules: share sum, per-recipient cap, no duplicate or zero addresses, basis-point range, and address format. Reports per-rule pass/fail and a deterministic config fingerprint. Validation only; no on-chain calls, no distribution. Not legal advice.
